name: sk-streaming-text
title: Streaming Text
description: Renders a model response at a steady reading cadence no matter how erratically the tokens arrive. It keeps a reveal cursor and drains toward the received length with a bounded catch-up rate, so a burst of forty tokens does not snap onto the screen and a stall does not freeze it. The caret is solid while glyphs land and blinks only while waiting.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKStreamingText(reply, isStreaming: isGenerating)
SKStreamingText(reply, isStreaming: true, charactersPerSecond: 90)
